what: Merged system simulation of the ZCU104 + DDR4 SO-DIMM socket + this card: headline results kept with the design. Transcribed from the stage-3 report (REPORT.md, results.json), the HFSS block manifest and the merge README; read by scripts/build_netlist.py into netlist.json analysis.system_simulation. Since then extended with three follow-up studies and the 0.50 V divider set now on the board (dividers_0v50, follow_up_studies).

files.server: ~/lpddr5_sys/stage3/ on the simulation server (deliver/REPORT.md, results.json, tables/, eyes/, scenarios/, scripts/; inspectable models in inspect/)
files.in_repository: none: the simulation files are not in the repository

board_simulated: the card as built at the time: CA / CK dividers 91R / 68R. The 75R / 56R result is an equivalent (a correction two-port on the card ports of block A, fitted to an earlier field solve with resistor ports; residual 0.013 of S to 2.4 GHz against a change of 0.085), not a new field solve

model.host: ZCU104 from the Xilinx ODB++ (16 layers, fabricated line widths)
model.socket: five HFSS blocks cut from the real artwork of both boards with the socket contacts and housing as solids: A command (fingers 60-90, 23 ports), B write (129-176, 48 ports), C read (176-226, 38 ports), D reset (226-238, 7 ports), E I2C / 3.3 V (247-260, 10 ports)
model.card: this card from its IPC-2581 export (6 layers)
model.merge: one SIwave project (host + card + block components), 179 ports, 0 - 5 GHz in 5 MHz steps with the true static row; merged against the plain cascade per wire to 5 GHz: command <= 0.0026, write DQ <= 0.0014, read <= 0.0045, WCK <= 0.0060, RESET_n 0.039
model.circuit: stand-alone Nexxim transients on the 75-port model; Vivado 2026.1 IBIS buffers (HP_SSTL12_F_OUT40, HP_MIPI_DPHY_DCI_F_OUT48 as receiver, HP_LVCMOS12_S_8) on the coupled Vivado package model; behavioural LPDDR5 pins (assumed)
model.corners: typ / slow / fast = IBIS typ / min / max, VCCO 1.20 / 1.14 / 1.26 V, DRAM read high 0.386 / 0.353 / 0.423 V into 150 ohm; 'paired' = pessimistic DRAM package coupling (assumed)
model.modes: M1 command stream 1.6 Gb/s; M2 writes 100 Mb/s; M3 reads 100 Mb/s; M4R / M4W = data plus the command bus at full rate plus injected noise (pessimistic supersets that this controller cannot produce)
model.hfss_convergence: block A last delta-S 0.0101 (target 0.01), block B 0.021 (target 0.02): not met; C, D, E met. Bound: command margin -12 .. -19 mV, write margin -2 .. -16 mV

fpga_driver_ibis_ohm.model: HP_SSTL12_F_OUT40 (SSTL12, SLEW FAST, RDRV_40_40, no DCI)

margin_definition: mask margin in mV at the receiver's sampling instant (smallest vertical distance between the JEDEC mask and the folded waveform; negative = violation), worst net of the class; 'best' = with the delay adjustment that training reaches

static_high_at_the_dram_pin_v.note: slow / typ / fast with the real driver, 91R / 68R as simulated, nominal resistors

ck_slew_at_the_pin.result_v_per_ns: 1.59 - 1.94 in slow and typ (fast 1.73 - 2.02) against the 2 V/ns minimum; 3.3 - 7.4 V/ns at the die
ck_slew_at_the_pin.cause: the unterminated pin behind the assumed DRAM package inductance (2.8 nH / 1.25 pF), a ledge at the crossing; not the driver, not the divider values (unchanged with 75R / 56R), not the model band (1.68 / 1.70 / 1.78 V/ns at 5 / 4 / 3 GHz), not jitter
ck_slew_at_the_pin.status: open: depends on the assumed DRAM package and must be measured on the bench

slvs_400_18.result_mV: +25 / -13 / +34 typ / slow / fast at VREF_RD 0.195 V (M4R: +16 / -23)
slvs_400_18.cause: in the weak-driver corner (read high 0.353 V) the high state has only 127 mV of differential against the 140 mV the standard needs
slvs_400_18.status: closed by decision: SLVS_400_18 dropped as a fall-back receiver; MIPI_DPHY_DCI is the only supported read receiver

divider_75r_56r_against_91r_68r.evidence: Nexxim on cascade models; block A changed by the equivalent two-port (post-processed)
divider_75r_56r_against_91r_68r.verdict: an improvement of 14 - 20 mV at the pin, not a repair: 91R / 68R also passes

noise_at_the_fpga_die_mV.m4r_typ_in_the_window: 22.4 - 28.9 pk-pk (upper bound: FPGA rail noise as delivered by the IBIS package; 1.5 - 9.3 with 2 nF of die decoupling per bank)

n_branch.sources: own P wire 20.4 mV pk-pk at the edge, 1.2 mV in the window (FPGA package P / N coupling); the seven neighbours 13.5 / 1.2 mV (made in the socket); RDQS 3.6 / 0.8; the reference network, DAC and shared VREF_RD bus below 0.01 mV in band
n_branch.level_mV: 194 - 196 at the set value 0.195 V; static error budget 16 mV (pin leakage 10, VDDQ 3.3, DAC and resistors 2.4)
n_branch.verdict: acceptable: 2 - 3 mV pk-pk when the receiver samples, at most 1 mV of +95 mV (typ) / +57 mV (slow) over the 70 mV sensitivity of MIPI_DPHY_DCI; with the 16 mV static budget +41 mV remain in the slow corner. What limits is the reference LEVEL, not the noise

vref_rd.rule: measure the read high level, set VREF_RD to half of it, keep it <= 0.21 V

examples.slow: read high 0.353 V -> VREF_RD 0.172 V: +80 mV (MIPI_DPHY_DCI) instead of +57 mV
examples.fast: 0.212 V: +121 mV, common mode 319 mV (11 mV inside)
examples.no_i2c: DAC Hi-Z, 0.187 V: typical corner unchanged (+96 mV)

front_back_skew.cause: front-side fingers arrive later through the socket (contact points 0.84 / 1.85 mm); the card's own match (641.77 ps on all ten nets) does not contain it
front_back_skew.odelay_note: starting values for training, not constants; from the final model, typ. An earlier run with CK +15 ps and CS +3 ps brought the centres within 1.3 .. 5.2 ps with margins unchanged within 6 mV
front_back_skew.cs: launched on the CA edges the CS eye centre is 288 - 301 ps before the rising CK crossing (margin +193 mV); half a UI later centres it; either is acceptable

write_return_path.finding: block B has no ground finger between 107 and 167: the write wires return through the 1.2 V fingers and the card's capacitors
write_return_path.effect_mV: eight DQ switching together: margin +115 / +100 (independent) -> +109 / +96 (all the same direction); a quiet DQ among seven sees <= 92 mV pk-pk over the UI, 37 - 56 mV in the latch window, >= 75 mV from the mask
write_return_path.crosstalk: the seven other DQ sum to 0.13 at 1 GHz where the own through is 0.26 (supply resonance 0.75 - 1.05 GHz); at 100 Mb/s nothing of it is left at the latch instant; no sensitivity case goes below +74 mV
write_return_path.mitigation: timing: launch DQ so that the DRAM latches 7 - 9.5 ns after the DQ edge (margin +128 .. +141 mV instead of +80 .. +118). SLEW SLOW on the write pins is not needed and not recommended

assumptions: DRAM pins, package and drivers are behavioural (no vendor IBIS): the CK slew at the pin, the pin-plane CA eye and the read levels depend on them
socket contact shapes (no LOTES drawing; Foxconn-based parametric model): front / back skew and echo phase
FPGA rail noise: the Vivado IBIS package as delivered has no die decoupling (upper bound); 2 nF per bank is assumed for the lower case
launch phases CA / CK, CS, WCK / DQ and the read capture instant; the split of the jitter bounds; injected noise amplitudes and the DRAM core current
nothing between 0 Hz and 5 MHz is solved: slow supply and reference effects are analytic
the mask shape between tIVW1 and tIVW2 (hexagon) and the 1.86 ns read window
the pin plane of the command bus is not fully converged at 5 GHz: +-12 mV of eye height, 2 - 4 mV of margin, no change of verdict
board_now: CA0-6 and CK 75R / 75R, WCK 75R / 75R, write DQ 110R / 100R, CS 33R / 100R (the 0.50 V set, dividers_0v50). The keys above this one (verdict, static_high_at_the_dram_pin_v, failures, divider_75r_56r_against_91r_68r, n_branch, vref_rd, write_return_path) are the stage-3 record of the board as it was then (91R / 68R and 75R / 56R on CA / CK, WCK 91R / 68R, DQ 240R / 150R) and are kept as history; front_back_skew and its ODELAY starting values come from that model too and were not re-derived for the 0.50 V set

dividers_0v50.decision: user: 'In general, we should only deviate from antmicro if there's a very clear reason to do so.' / 'Design the dividers so they give 0.50 typical like the antmicro ones' / 'Simulate these new dividers and generate new eyes.'

set.write_DQ: 110R / 100R (from 240R / 150R); the shunt is also the read load

dividers_0v50.source: ~/lpddr5_sys/stage3/deliver/div_0v50/ (DIV0V50.md, div050_tables.md, cs_crosstalk.md, eyes/, figures/); model D50_hiz, all five 3D blocks, divider equivalents; 43 Nexxim runs
dividers_0v50.evidence: Nexxim transients on the system model; the dividers are changed by a circuit correction on the solved blocks (divider_changes_are_circuit_corrections), not by a field re-solve

static_high_at_the_dram_pin_v.note: slow / typ / fast, real driver, nominal resistors, DC of the transient

commands.ca_die_margin_typ_slow_fast_mV: +66 / +67 / +66 (was +80 / +72 / +86: the eye sits later against CK; at the best position +91 against +84 typ)
commands.verdict: pass on every mask; CK slew at the ball still starts below 2 V/ns (+0.12 V/ns from the larger swing; the ledge is unchanged, follow_up_studies.ck_slew)

writes.vref_dq_note: the simulation took 225 mV as the top of the MR14 range and evaluated there, 20 mV off the centre of the eye. JESD209-5C Table 91 note 4 gives 225 mV as the ceiling for WCK above 1600 MHz and 350 mV at or below 1600 MHz, so the centre is reachable on this card; no run was made above 225 mV
writes.quiet_dq_among_seven_pk_pk_mV: 16.7 in the latch window (94 over the whole UI); before 36.9 (80)

reads.load: the 100 ohm shunt (150 ohm before); RDQS loads unchanged at 150 ohm
reads.n_branch_noise_typ_mV: 2.6 pk-pk / 0.38 rms in the window, read alone; 29.0 / 4.17 with everything active; margin lost 0.9 / 8.8
reads.verdict: pass with MIPI_DPHY_DCI; about 40 mV less read level, 6 mV less margin typ and 15 mV less in the slow corner once VREF_RD is re-centred
reads.after_the_simulation: the simulated reference network was 300R (DAC) / 300R (VDDQ) / 180R (GND): default 0.187 V, source 82 ohm. On the board now, by two later decisions of the user: R333 = 160R and R332 (the VDDQ leg) NOT FITTED. VREF_RD = 0.3478 x Vdac, 0 .. 0.631 V, 0 V until the DAC is written, source 104 ohm. The simulated margins hold at the simulated reference values once the DAC is set to them; the N-branch noise with the 104 ohm source was not re-simulated; no run exists with the reference at 0 V (reads do not work there)

levels_against_vddq.allowance: JESD209-5C Table 416: 0.3 V and 0.1 V-ns beyond VDDQ. 'standing' = DC level above VDDQ for as long as the line is high; 'transient' = ringing above max(DC level, VDDQ)

standing_above_vddq_0p500_v_mV.typ_and_slow: none against 0.500 V; typ is 7-8 mV above the card's 0.488 V minimum

levels_against_vddq.share_of_time_above_0p500_v: CA 1 / 20 / 35 % slow / typ / fast; write DQ 0 / 11 / 52 %; WCK legs 12 / 48 % typ / fast; CK legs 1 / 11 %
levels_against_vddq.undershoot: unchanged: at most 0.11 V and 0.068 V-ns
levels_against_vddq.reading: amplitude inside 0.3 V everywhere; the transient part alone inside 0.1 V-ns everywhere (CA fast 0.097); read literally the area allowance is exceeded in the fast corner on CA (0.19 V-ns), write DQ (1.4) and WCK (0.38) only because the line rests above VDDQ

currents_typ_mA.path: host bank VCCO through the signal fingers; not the card's 1.2 V feed

cs.question: what the large CS swing costs the CA lines; CS 33R / 100R as designed against a hypothetical 75R / 75R (typ and slow; fast not run)
cs.ca2_jitter_pk_pk_ps: about 120 with CS toggling, 95 with CS held; its margin does not drop
cs.where_it_is_made: before the divider, where CS swings 1.2 V in both cases: mainly the FPGA package (CA2 on ball AN19 beside CS on AM19), then the socket block; the card adds almost nothing
cs.verdict: CS at 0.73 V costs the CA lines nothing measurable; a 0.50 V CS fails its own mask (Vref_CS fixed at VDD2H / 3 = 0.35 V) and sits under the 0.55 V power-down-exit level in every corner: CS keeps 33R / 100R

variants_not_built.82r_82r: 0.464 / 0.502 / 0.539 V; 3 mV closer to 0.500 V but CA pin margin +57 / +58 / +56 mV (8-17 mV worse)

dividers_0v50.not_done: slow and fast corners at the default VREF_RD; fast corner of the CS crosstalk cases; everything-active only in typ; no field re-solve

antmicro_reference_comparison.what: the Antmicro lpddr5-testbed on its sodimm-ddr5-tester (Kintex-7 XC7K160T, DDR5 SO-DIMM socket, 100R / 100R dividers) through the same pipeline, masks, planes and stimulus; its system model is a cascade (its merged solve is not passive)
antmicro_reference_comparison.cause: the Kintex-7 HSUL_12 SLEW SLOW buffer (0.3 ns edge, 4.68 pF), not the boards or the socket; the larger eye in mV with the same driver is the higher level (0.54 V against 0.43 V), the eye relative to the level is alike (0.77 against 0.68-0.75)
antmicro_reference_comparison.cs: Antmicro uses 100R / 100R on CS too (0.54 V against Vref_CS 0.35 V): +4 mV even with the fast buffer; this card's 33R / 100R gives +193 mV
antmicro_reference_comparison.ck_pin: Antmicro at 800 MHz 2.4-2.9 V/ns (twice the swing per leg), at its own 60 MHz 1.73-1.77 V/ns and Vix 24.8 %; this card 1.6-2.0 V/ns, Vix 5 %
antmicro_reference_comparison.writes_100_mbps_mV: Antmicro +162 / +164 (height 540 mV) against +80 / +82 here with 240R / 150R; at its own 480 Mb/s +5 / +18 / -4 at the best instant
antmicro_reference_comparison.reads_100_mbps_mV: Antmicro single-ended against VREF +-100 mV: +64 / +45 / +85; this card P - N with MIPI_DPHY_DCI: +95 / +57 / +104 (150 ohm load)
antmicro_reference_comparison.read_crosstalk: 11 % in the reference against 5.7 % here (DDR5 pin pattern: two signal contacts between grounds)
antmicro_reference_comparison.command_skew_ps: 51-60 between the CA eye centres in the reference (not length-matched) against 19-27 here
antmicro_reference_comparison.not_like_for_like: Kintex-7 IBIS is not power-aware (ideal rail); socket contact shapes assumed for both; reference blocks A / B missed the HFSS target (0.025 / 0.036 against 0.02)

div_100_100_what_if.what: Antmicro's literal 100R / 100R on this board: case 1 CA / CK only, case 2 also write DQ and WCK
div_100_100_what_if.ca_pin_margin_typ_slow_fast_mV: +27 (best +69) / +28 (+59) / +22 (+70): about half of 91R / 68R and a third of 75R / 56R; the loss is a shift of the eye against CK (best position 66-93 ps late), not eye closure
div_100_100_what_if.verdict: not taken: the divider is no longer matched to the 45.6 ohm line, so the CA eye moves against CK. The 0.50 V set (75R / 75R) keeps the match and gives +72 mV where 100R / 100R gives +27 mV, at a level 22 mV lower

ck_slew.source: ~/lpddr5_sys/stage3/deliver/ck_slew/CK_SLEW.md, ck_tables.md (baseline 75R / 56R; with the 0.50 V set the pin slew is 0.12 V/ns higher, same ledge)
ck_slew.finding: low only at the ball: 1.67-2.00 V/ns typ, 1.61-1.91 slow, 1.72-2.09 fast against 2-14; at the die, where the receiver is, 5.3-7.0 / 4.5-6.0 / 6.0-8.0 V/ns. With the 0.50 V set 1.80-2.11 / 1.73-2.03 / 1.84-2.18 at the ball, 5.9-7.8 at the die (typ)
ck_slew.mechanism: a ledge at the zero crossing made by the reflection from the un-terminated die: the first wave is about 55 % of the step, the rest arrives twice the package delay later (2 x 59 ps, assumed). The ledge sits inside the +-145 mV measuring window; all edges are monotonic at both planes
ck_slew.where_jedec_places_it: JESD209-5C 12.2.1: the input voltage has to satisfy Vindiff_CK 'at input receiver'; Tables 417-422 carry no 'at the pin' note (the CA table 466 does). Read literally the requirement is at the receiver, where the slew is 4.5-8.0 V/ns
ck_slew.what_does_not_help: nothing that is free: DRAM CK ODT (240 / 120 ohm: 1.57-1.90 / 1.46-1.82 V/ns) and a resistor across the pair (1.44-1.86) cut the swing and leave the ledge; more swing gives +0.05 .. +0.18 V/ns; two buffers in parallel +0.11 (no spare pins); pre-emphasis could not be simulated
ck_slew.fallback_unverified: CK legs 22R / 27R (four resistor values): 3.81-6.69 V/ns typ (every edge), 1.73-5.39 slow (99 % of the edges), 4.83-7.96 fast; peaks 0.67 / 0.77 V on a leg (27 mV from the 0.3 V amplitude limit in the fast corner), +7.5 mA, and the CK launch must move by 80-110 ps (CA margin +1 mV unmoved, +86 mV at the best position). The divider equivalent is used at a 4.1x change of the series value, outside the range in which it was checked (2.4x); the model was non-passive above 4.5 GHz and clipped. A re-extraction of the launch block is needed before committing
ck_slew.status: bring-up item: measure the CK edge at the ball / estimate the package delay; nothing changed on the board

divider_changes_are_circuit_corrections.statement: the HFSS blocks were solved once, with the resistors of the board as it was then: block A (command) with 91R / 68R, block B (write) with 240R / 150R and WCK 91R / 68R. Every divider value simulated since (75R / 56R, 100R / 100R, 75R / 75R, 82R / 82R, 110R / 100R, the CK-only dividers) is a circuit correction on the ports of those blocks, not a field re-solve

command_block_residual.method: correction two-port, checked against a solve with explicit resistor ports; S-parameter magnitude up to 2.4 GHz: size of the change / residual of the equivalent
command_block_residual.checked_range: up to a 2.4x change of the series value (residual 0.069 on a change of 0.31)

write_block_residual.method: no resistor-port solve exists: the block is rebuilt around a T-model of each divider
write_block_residual.identity_test: rebuilt with unchanged values against the solved block: 0.011 to 1 GHz, 0.028 to 2.4 GHz, 0.068 to 5 GHz; 2-3 mV of write margin, 1 mV of read margin
write_block_residual.110r_100r_wck_75r_75r: non-passive above 4 GHz, clipped (change at most 0.043 above 4 GHz, 0.0005 below); DC exact
write_block_residual.least_certain: the same ladder tried on the command-launch solve for 240R / 150R -> 110R / 100R leaves 0.05 on the through path up to 2.4 GHz (0.35 at 5 GHz); not quantified in the eye. Write and read data live below 1 GHz, where the error is smallest

divider_changes_are_circuit_corrections.expect: about +-5 mV on the margins from the equivalent itself
